name: waterloo-docstrings
description: Tools for Waterloo docstrings in Python.

waterloo.showSuccessNotifications.description: Show information notifications after successful Waterloo actions.

waterloo.mcpProvideServer.description: Provide a Waterloo MCP stdio server definition to VS Code.

waterloo.mcpCommand.description: Command used to start the Waterloo MCP stdio server.

waterloo.mcpConfigPath.description: Absolute path to wtrl_mcp.stdio.toml. If empty, common workspace locations are tried.

waterloo.mcpServerLabel.description: Human-readable label for the provided MCP server.

editor/context.when: resourceLangId == python && editorTextFocus && waterloo.backendReady && waterloo.cap.any && waterloo.isFuncClassOrModuleLine

waterloo.context.when: resourceLangId == python && editorTextFocus && waterloo.backendReady && waterloo.cap.generateMinimalDocstring && waterloo.isFuncClassOrModuleLine
resourceLangId == python && editorTextFocus && waterloo.backendReady && waterloo.cap.generateFullDocstring && waterloo.isFuncClassOrModuleLine
resourceLangId == python && editorTextFocus && waterloo.backendReady && waterloo.cap.validateDocstring && waterloo.isFuncClassOrModuleLine
